title: 2027 Audit Technology Graduate Programme - London (Technology Risk Assurance: Data or Controls)
work_model: In person / office and client based; must live within commutable distance of London
key_requirements: Minimum 2:2 degree in any discipline (obtained or predicted). Three A-levels A*-C or equivalent. GCSE Maths and English grade 4+. Right to work in the UK; no visa sponsorship available. Curious, resilient, adaptable; problem-solving, analytical skills and critical thinking; commitment to balance study with professional work.
key_responsibilities: IT General Controls testing over financial applications; cyber security risk assessments; database and operating systems controls testing; assessment of automated controls; exploring and analysing data with Alteryx, Databricks, Python, SQL, SAS; checking and validating financial information; presenting insights and building visualisations and dashboards.
